findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

Observed a food handler to wash hands appropriately, dry hands with paper towels, and then turn off the faucet handles with no barrier such as a paper towel (cross contamination). Discussed with employee. Inspector asked employee to properly re-wash their hands. Utilize a barrier such as a paper towel to turn off faucet handles after adequately washing hands. Ensure staff is aware of proper hand washing techniques. Discussed with PIC who was with Inspector throughout the inspection. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

Observed the sani bucket in the kitchen to be low - 10 ppm. Discussed with PIC. PIC had an employee re-make the sani bucket. Bucket concentration of bleach was likely low due to being after lunch hour. Discussed changing buckets out after lunch in order to maintain appropriate concentration of bleach - 50 to 200 ppm. Facility has test strips to check concentrations. Bleach bucket re-tested at 200 ppm. COS. Ensure staff is aware to frequently change sani buckets to maintain concentration limits.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Observed the following areas to be in need of cleaning:
1. The hood system is heavily stained black and has residue on the baffles above the main pizza oven area. Per the sticker on the hood system, Rock Solid services the facility 2x yearly. Last cleaning service was March 2023. Ensure services comes as needed to maintain the area. PIC indicated Rock Solid cleans the entire hood area and staff cleans behind the equipment and the walls during the bi-annual cleaning services.
2. The reach-in cooler across from the main kitchen prep area (with the ovens) has dust on the interior fan grates. Ensure staff routinely cleans the interior fans of the coolers. The other reach-in cooler (near the reach-in freezers by the pizza prep area) had only a minor amount of dust. PIC was in compliance to clean and maintain cleaning of the interior fans grates.
3. The area with the pizza box/tray shelving (above the pizza dough prep area) has quite a bit of flour/dust on the shelving grates. The rolling shelving cart with the flour in this area has flour and dust on it as well. The ceiling tiles/vent directly above this area (in front of the walk-in cooler) has flour/dust. The area is heavily affected by the amount of dust during the dough making process. Ensure the area is cleaned as needed to keep shelving units, roller carts, and the ceilings clean. PIC was in compliance.
4. Both squeezers of the dish machine and 3 compartment sink areas have grime/debris on the handles and on/under the spray squeezer. Discussed routinely using stainless steel wool to scrub the scum off. Ensure dish washing staff is aware.

Discussed routine cleaning of the above areas with PIC. Ensure staff is aware. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs (to be smooth, easily cleanable, non-absorbent):
1. The hand sink in the main kitchen needs re-caulked to the wall. The interior creases of the hand sink have moldy caulking. Creases need re-caulked.
2. Mop sink needs re-caulked due to significantly moldy caulking around the basin.
3. Three compartment sink needs re-caulked to the wall due to moldy caulking.
4. The dish machine area needs caulked to the wall. There is a visible gap between the wall and the dish machine equipment. Caulk the dish machine equipment to the wall.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before the next routine inspection.

findings.citation_text:
750.160 - Employee working in dough prep area was observed adjusting his hat with gloved hands and returning to prep without changing gloves. Manager on duty was advised that, since dough will be cooked, gloves do not have to be worn during dough prep as long as hands are properly washed before working with dough and as needed throughout the process. findings.title: Pre-flushed, scraped, soaked
findings.citation_text: 750.830 - Multiple containers had old day dots stuck on them in addition to current stickers. Day dots need to be thoroughly removed from the containers during ware washing process to ensure proper cleaning, and also to eliminate potential for confusion with date marking. Equipment and utensils shall be pre-flushed or pre-scraped and, when necessary, pre-soaked to remove gross food particles and soil prior to their being cleaned in a dishwashing machine unless a pre-wash cycle is a part of the dishwashing machine operation. If equipment and utensils are still soiled after ware washing process then complete steps as many times as necessary to ensure all soil is removed.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - Sanitizer buckets used for wiping general surface were at less than 100ppm chlorine. Top inside buckets also had grimy, black buildup. Buckets were taken to dish area to be scrubbed prior to making new solutions (100ppm). In addition to running sanitizer buckets through dish machine, the inside needs to be scrubbed periodically to eliminate gross buildup. Buildup inside the bucket may cause chlorine to wear down faster. Also, make sure the water used to make the solution is luke warm so bleach does not dissolve out rapidly. Maintain sanitizer solution for general surfaces at 100ppm.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited

Observed 4 alive, small, brown beetle-like insects and 3 dead ones on the pizza dough press in the back of the kitchen.  Orkin treats facility monthly and are due this week.  I called Orkin and spoke with Virgil, the service manager, about what kind of insect this might be since it did not resemble a roach.  He stated that it could be a common "pantry pest" or "flour beetle" that the routine pest control would not treat, but that they arrive in facility via the flour.  He suggests checking their current stock, rotating often, and if this pest is observed again, to check with the vendor, which is Monical's Pizza Corp, about how long the product is stored.  I could not read the date on the flour the facility was using, but they did not seem to have too much product on hand.  The dough press was cleaned and sanitized during inspection and a follow-up inspection will be conducted in one week.

Sanitizer solution must be changed out every 2-4 hours or more often if needed (i.e. solution/rags are heavily soiled). Sanitizer solution was remade during the inspection and tested at 100ppm chlorine.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) ice machine - sides & corner of drip guard (mold/buildup) & B) top inside microwave. Wash, rinse, and sanitize the above items and all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris and prevent cross contamination. **Clean/sanitize and rotate pizza slicers every 2-4 hours or more often if they become heavily soiled**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floor behind dish machine along the wall was soiled. Clean the floor behind the dish machine. Clean all floors and floor drains throughout daily/as needed.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Walls under equipment in dish area and attached plumbing  were soiled. Clean the walls and the attached plumbing in the dish area daily/as needed.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.citation_text: 750.1390 - Wet mop heads were observed to be stored in mop buckets. Store mops hanging or inverted between uses to allow for proper drying of mop heads. **Wet mop heads can serve as a food and water source for pests.**

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.citation_text: 750.151 - Containers of tomato sauce in prep table had 8/2 as a date mark. One container also had a date of 8/27 on it. Manager discarded the sauce in question. Properly date mark all ready to eat, potentially hazardous foods that will be held cold for longer than 24 hours; use or discard products w/in 7 days. Date of preparation (marinara heated)/opening of original packaging (can of tomato paste or vegetables opened, package of ham opened, etc.) counts as day 1. For example, any products prepared/opened on 8/17 must be used or discarded by the end of the business day on 8/23. **Stickers don't come off easily. Make sure correct date is marked on stickers. Questionable products will be discarded**

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) walkin cooler - milk crate (appeared to have mold on it) & (R) shelves & bakers rack; B) (R) area where soda nozzles attach to the soda machine; C) shelves next to walkin cooler; D) shelves under microwaves; E) catch trays of conveyor oven; F) outside/top of dish machine & electrical box; G) shelves by dish room; H) back of shelves on salad prep table; I) hood filters; J) lower shelves of prep table across from ovens & K) inside cheese sauce dispenser. Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces regularly/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - (R) Floor under dish machine was soiled (dirt buildup, broken dishes, plastic container - appeared to be same debris from last inspection). Clean the floor under the dish machine. Clean all floors and floor drains throughout daily/as needed.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Walls under equipment in dish area and attached plumbing  were soiled. Clean the walls and the attached plumbing in the dish area daily/as needed.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled/remain to be addressed by the next routine inspection: A) shelves & bakers rack in walkin cooler; B) where soda nozzles attach to soda machines; C) bottom inside/tracks of 2 door cooler (by drive thru); D) dough prep area - dough press (surfaces below/around food contact surface), cords of equipment, bases of hot water dispensers (including underside), & shelves above prep table/next to walkin cooler. Clean the above items/areas. **Clean all non-food contact surfaces regularly/as needed including all shelves throughout and inside/outside of all equipment.**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - The floor under the dish machine was soiled/remains to be addressed by the next routine inspection. **Clean the floors throughout daily/as needed, especially under equipment (soda machines, ice machine, shelves, etc.).**

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.citation_text: 750.160 - Employee was observed cutting tomatoes for salads with his bare hands. Employees shall minimize bare hand contact with ready to eat foods. Single use gloves need to be worn in addition to thorough handwashing when working with ready to eat foods. Employee was done cutting the tomatoes by the time the inspector observed what was happening. Manager on duty and regional manager were present and discussed proper handwashing/glove use with the inspector.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) catch trays for conveyor oven; B) where soda nozzles attach to soda machines; C) bottom inside/tracks of 2 door cooler (drive thru); D) metal shelves with boxes & warmers by front counter; E) dough prep area - dough press (surfaces below/around food contact surface), cords of equipment, bases of hot water dispensers, & shelves above prep table/next to walkin cooler; F) shelves in walkin cooler. Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces regularly/as needed, including shelves and inside/outside of equipment. **Catch trays for the conveyor oven were cleaned during the inspection**

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.citation_text: 750.1160 - Cluster of gnats were observed hovering above floor drain located between the ice machine and soda machine in food prep area. Gnats were not observed in large numbers anywhere else in the kitchen. Thoroughly clean the floors, floor drains/covers throughout and call your pest control operator for service if necessary. Thorough/routine cleaning is necessary to minimize the presence of pests.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - The floor drain between the ice machine and soda machine in food prep area had what appeared to be mold buildup in it. The floor under the dish machine, under shelves in walkin cooler, and under soda machines/ice machine were soiled. Thoroughly clean all floor drains, esp. the drains for soda machines and dish machine, and floors throughout under equipment daily/as needed to eliminate potential food sources for pests. Minimize presence of standing water as much as possible to eliminate potential water sources for pests.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750.1310b - Spray bottle of Spic n Span all purpose cleaner was observed hanging on metal shelf above bags of flour in dough prep area. Store toxic chemicals separate from/below food and all food related items (to go boxes, utensils, etc.). Manager on duty moved the spray bottle to the appropriate chemical storage location.
